Episode 201. The Invasion Begins (2)

The Jo-Ryong Sung-chae was a training ground for Hairan's Dragon Knights and a place to foster their companions, the Jo-Ryong. The Red Plutonian chose this place as their next hunting ground after the Zipple 2nd class magic tower.

The land where the Jo-Ryong Sung-chae is located, the 'Kwassel Plain', was populated entirely by Dragon Knights, trainees, and Jo-Ryongs due to the nature of Dragon Knight training and security maintenance.
What the Red Plutonian needed was the blood of strong lifeforms.

From the Red Plutonian's perspective, they were easy to acquire and excellent nourishment. Jo-Ryongs, even though they were fluids, held value surpassing that of Baeklang or Jeokho tribes, and the same went for the Dragon Knights.

Furthermore, the defense capabilities of the Jo-Ryong Sung-chae were laughable from the Red Plutonian's standards. The Red Plutonian swiftly took control of the airspace above the Jo-Ryong Sung-chae through dimensional travel and fleet descent, just as they showed during the 2nd class magic tower attack.
The Red Plutonian's red fleet fired relentlessly as soon as they arrived.
The sudden barrage from the sky turned the entire Sung-chae into a war zone in a few seconds.
Given the attack was made through spatial leap, naturally, there was no chance for the Dragon Knights to prepare, nor an apparent way to respond.
"How dare you...."
Clang!
Dante gritted his teeth as he deflected the falling debris and shrapnel above his head.
Usually, Dante works in Hairan's Second Castle, but today he was at Jo-Ryong Sung-chae to inspect the Dragon Knights.
If Dante hadn't been there now.
The Red Plutonian would have easily and swiftly enjoyed a massacre and looting, then leisurely exited Kwassel.
"Lord, are you alright!"
"I'm fine, take care of the young knights and Jo-Ryongs!"
"Yes!"
"Rescue them and evacuate immediately. They're not opponents you can confront. And send the fastest Dragon Knight to Hairan's Second Castle to report this."
"Understood!"
The knights who were by his side dispersed, pushing away the debris from the collapsed meeting room.
Dante was filled with an indescribably deep and raging anger, but he maintained his reason and stepped outside. There were more than a hundred red warships visibly surrounding the Sung-chae.

Everyone present in the central hall with Dante were all top-tier Dragon Knights. So they hadn't suffered much damage from the initial bombardment, but it wasn't the same for the other Dragon Knights and Jo-Ryongs. The leader of the Dragon Knights, Kalmain, was absent, and the elite Dragon Knights had all been dispatched throughout the empire.

Nearby, they could see the bodies of the dead Dragon Knights and Jo-Ryongs, and they could hear the screams of their subordinates. Dante calmly scanned the enemy's flagship with sharp eyes and drew his sword.
'Is this the Red Plutonian tribe that Jin mentioned, it's not just their fleet that's powerful. There's an exceptional talent among the crew.'
Dante instinctively knew this.
The commander of the Red Plutonian tribe's red fleet that surrounded the castle was Drek Hon.
He was the leader of the Red Plutonian Khan tribe and the newly awakened War King. And unlike Rakiman, he had almost completely regained his powers from his prime.
"Isn't that human known as the Sword Emperor in the human world? His appearance matches, and his energy is also impressive. Henji tribesman, why is he here?"
"I'm sorry, Drek tribesman. As Dante Hairan is currently the head of the empire, it was difficult to determine his schedule precisely."
"I see, I understand. Then understand that you, Henji tribesman, will become an immortal soldier by my will from now on."
Before the Red Plutonian named Henji could answer, Drek grabbed his head.
"Argh, no, aaah..."

Then, Henji's massive body was grotesquely transformed in an instant, like a twig. The blood pouring out from his body turned into red particles and was absorbed into Drek's hand. Plop! The sound of a still-beating heart falling to the floor tightened the tension among the Red Plutonian tribe.
"Open the gangway. I have a proposal for the Sword Emperor."
As the flagship's gangway was opened, Dante could see Drek. Drek looked down at Dante and squinted his eyes with interest.

"Sword Emperor, I am Drek Hon, the War King of the Red Plutonian tribe. I'll give you a chance. Abandon this worthless castle and run away right now. Then I won't take your life today. We will return after taking a fair amount of blood, and you can prepare for the future."
Dante wanted to go up and kill Drek right away, but he held his tongue to buy time. So that the scattered knights could gather the injured trainees and Jo-Ryongs just a little bit more.
Drek saw through him and smirked.
"No matter how clumsily you try to buy time, all the humans here today will end up as our nourishment anyway."
Emperor's sword draw, heaven-piercing one-cut.
As soon as Drek finished speaking, Rashid emitted light. A huge sword energy that seemed to sweep the entire red fleet in front was fired.

But Drek blocked Dante's attack with just the shield of the fleet, without using his own power. Drek's power, the performance of the fleet, and its firepower were incomparable to when Rakiman attacked Kinzelo's 3rd branch.

"Is this your answer? Indeed, a sword worthy of being called the Sword Emperor. I'm tempted to come down and cross weapons directly... But we didn't come here for a duel. It's an invasion. It's a pity."
The bridge closed and Drekk's figure disappeared. Dante roared and launched a series of Sky-Piercing Strikes, but the fleet's shield only glowed redder.
Even if the red fleet's shield was powerful, it could not withstand Dante's constant attacks.

The problem, however, was that Dante didn't have control of the battlefield. While the red fleet could unilaterally strike from the sky, even targeting the entire castle, Dante had to fight while protecting the dragon knights and dragons.

The bombardment started again. The relentless bombardment, filled with malicious intent, was trampling the Dragon Castle. Because he recognized Dante's presence, Drekk ordered a much more intense bombardment than at first.
'I can't save everyone.'
Dante had to admit it. With his current ability, he could not protect everyone here.
Perhaps, it might have been a wiser choice to accept Drekk's offer and flee. After all, Drekk also wanted to avoid a battle with Dante now, and to simply gather his prey and leave.
But the first piece of good luck in today's unfortunate events at the Dragon Castle was Dante's arrival.
The second was that Dante was not alone.
Whoosh... Bang!
Suddenly, an explosion occurred in the enemy encirclement in the upper left sky. Someone had attacked the rear of the fleet gathered there.
Until now, the enemy tribe had concentrated power on the forward shield to block Dante's attacks, so the rear was relatively vulnerable.

No matter how excellent the enemy tribe's ship was, it could not withstand the strike of the strongest force on the ground without a shield. The enemy tribe hastily deployed rear shields, but they had already lost two ships.
"......I should have asked about that man before giving Henji the honor of becoming immortal."
Drekk sighed, looking at the left fleet.
"Is it Hedo this time, the core executive of the Vamel Alliance?"
Hedo.

Immediately after hearing the news that Zipple's 2nd-level Magic Tower was attacked, Jin sent Hedo to the Empire. He judged it was too much for Dante alone to defend the empire until a proper countermeasure was found against the enemy tribe's attack pattern.

"From now on, all ships except the flagship concentrate on attacking Dante and Hedo. We'll catch the fleeing prey. The flagship will fully open its power source. I'll personally amplify the brain energy. It'd be good to take care of at least one of them today."
The bombardment that had been falling all over the castle began to focus on the two men.

Thanks to this, it seemed that the reserve knights and dragons could evacuate more easily, but it was only for a moment. As soon as Drekk connected his core heart to the power source, the firepower of the flagship 'Baryon' increased.

Wings spread from both sides of the Varion, sparking fierce lightning. Dante and Hedo, having never properly experienced the enemy fleet, were instinctively wary but did not stop the fledgling dragon knights from taking flight. They believed the best course of action would be for them to escape by flying on the dragons while the two of them held off the barrage.
However, the enemy brainwaves emanating from the wings of Varion, in an instant, engulfed the skies above the Quashel Plains and sent the dragons crashing down.

The sky engulfed by Varion's enemy brainwaves resembled a lava field, possessing the attribute of annihilating any object in mid-air like the red ring barriers of the Imperial Special Forces. Of course, its power was incomparably stronger than those barriers.
"Kiaaak!"
"Kiieek……!”
The dragons were reduced to ashes and fell to the ground. The aspiring knights on board all became ashes too, and Dante, suppressing the surge of emptiness, brandished his sword at the flagship.
However, he couldn't close the distance due to the onslaught of incoming fire. All the ships, except Varion, were pressing Dante and Hedo.
With no choice, the fleeing dragon knights had to run on foot. The dragons foamed and writhed as they ran, and Varion seemed intolerant of even this, firing at them.
Simply put, there was no safe way for the dragon knights to escape, either in the sky or on the ground.
"Sword Emperor! If this goes on, the dragon knights will be annihilated soon."
Hedo shouted, standing next to Dante.
"Sir Hedo."
"Then you should directly protect the matrix and retreat from the battlefield. Go to Hairan 2-star as fast as you can and call Jin on the communicator. I'll hold them off by myself until then."
If they were not to abandon all the dragon knights, that was the best option.
However, Dante thought that he should naturally take on the more dangerous role. It was clear that staying here in the Dragon Castle was a matter of life and death.
This was the empire, the territory of Hairan, and he was the head of Hairan.
"……I'd rather stay. Sir Hedo, you go!"
"No, you're strong but you're frail."
"Are you talking about the old days? It's right for Sir Hedo to go."

"Even so, are you, the Sword Emperor, stronger than me? If I get hurt, I just have to heal, but if you die, it's a matter that shakes the entire empire. So there's no time for this. Go call Jin! If you refuse, I'll fold you in half, regardless of the enemy or whatever. I'm serious."
At Hedo's strong stance, Dante had no choice but to nod.
"……Understood. I won't forget this favor, Sir Hedo!"
Hedo watched Dante retreat and stared at the enemies.
"Huh, it's tough. Let's see how long I can hold out."
